limits: Young deposits (Quaternary units) come from the 1:24,000 map where it reaches (north to 38.625 N); older rock, and everything beyond that map, from SIM 2956 at 1:100,000 (a line roughly 50 m wide on the ground). Each unit lists the map(s) it came from. Transparent cells are outside both maps.
